name: Housing Density
description:
Every residential building in Stratford, sorted by how many homes it holds. The switch at the top of the Map key changes the view: Dots shows each building, Heatmap shows where homes are most concentrated, and Streets totals the homes or buildings on each street, or shows how many households would travel along each street if everyone drove to one spot you pick.

Building outlines are from the Province's 2026 building layer, with newer buildings added by hand. Home counts and streets are kept up to date by hand as the town grows. The traffic view is a rough guide: every household takes the shortest route, without speed limits, traffic lights, or trips to places outside Stratford.
